candidates.CE: European baseline: the research model team_form_poisson_v1 exactly as live runs it for UCL and UEL today: Dixon-Coles goal rates and ten-match form from the competition's own European results before the fold origin (uses no odds and no domestic results)
candidates.CE2: CE's home/away split rescaled by a slope fitted walk-forward on CE's own earlier European forecasts (european_candidates; per competition only when each competition has 1,000 earlier decided matches, otherwise pooled; neutral below 300)
candidates.CE2c: Context: CE2 always fitted per competition
candidates.CE2p: Context: CE2 always pooled over UCL and UEL
candidates.CE3: CE's goal rates blended (domestic weight 0.85) with domestic research strength (league Dixon-Coles and last-ten form, Understat xG where it exists) put on the European scale by league-strength factors fitted walk-forward on earlier European results; CE exactly where a team has no domestic form
candidates.CE3n: Context: CE3 with goals-only domestic form (no xG)
candidates.CE4: CE3 followed by CE2's calibration, the slope refitted on CE3's own earlier forecasts

calibration_rule.decided_note: Decided on 12 Nov 2026, before any European holdout scoring (evaluation/european_holdout_ledger.json has no entry). Applies only to candidates not yet scored on a holdout; v2 stays for C6's record.
calibration_rule.name: slopes-0.90-1.10-or-closer-than-baseline-bands-30-5pp-bonferroni-v3
calibration_rule.rule: Relative slopes. Each of the candidate's home and away logistic calibration slopes (logit P(outcome) = a + b logit(p), fitted per outcome) passes if it is between 0.90 and 1.10 inclusive, OR its distance from 1.0 is smaller than the declared baseline's slope for the same outcome on the same fixtures (both slopes fitted on the fixtures both forecast). Bands exactly as v2: no outcome probability band (home, draw and away, tenths of probability, at least 30 matches) more than 5 percentage points from its observed rate AND statistically clear (|gap| / sqrt(p(1-p)/n) above the two-sided normal quantile for 0.05 divided by the number of bands checked; Bonferroni), p = the band's mean forecast.

declaration.holdout: European holdout: UCL, 21 Jan 2025 - 12 Oct 2026 (288 fixtures, 29 weeks; 277 reachable by identity); evaluation_harness.py --mode european --declaration, recorded in evaluation/european_holdout_ledger.json
declaration.notes: Scored once. No rerun, no change to the setup after it, and no other candidate scored on the European holdout. If it passes, next are the parity test and the live replay, including loading the backfilled European history in live; if not proven, production is unchanged and CE3n stays offline.
declaration.pass_rule: Passes only if CE minus CE3n log loss on AH all lines is positive with the week-resampled 95% interval clear of zero, the sample minimum (250 fixtures, 6 weeks) is met, and CE3n's holdout forecasts pass calibration rule v3 against CE on the same fixtures (holdout_verdict.passes_holdout_gate).
reported_not_gating: UCL league phase and UCL knockouts separately (context, CE minus CE3n with week-resampled 95% intervals from the run's own fixture_scores.csv)
declaration.results_only_reason: No historical European prices are cached (the only European odds are live Odds API snapshots from Oct-Nov 2026, which are not used), so the European holdout has no market reference, no cagey tier, no published-grid proxy and no market bar. CE3n is judged against CE on the result alone.
declaration.setup: Reviewed aliases on every European fixture (approved by Paul 12 Nov 2026), calibration rule v3 (decided 12 Nov 2026), both before any European holdout scoring. CE3n as built in PR #160 (domestic weight 0.85, goals-only domestic form, league factors with N(0, 0.3^2) prior); nothing tuned on the holdout.

holdout_verdict.next_steps: Passing the holdout is necessary, not sufficient: parity test and live replay follow, then a reviewed PR.

notes: Results only: no historical European prices are cached, so there is no market reference (M), no cagey tier (D), no published-grid proxy (A) and no market bar. Log loss is against the result alone.
Calibration rules v2 (calibration_tolerance_check) and v3 (calibration_tolerance_rules, each candidate against CE) are reported for information; only a declared run applies one, as a gate.
CE is the research model as live runs it for UCL/UEL, without the ESPN form live adds (the harness has none) and with history to the fold origin.
Retrospective results were already scored elsewhere: diagnostics only, never release evidence.
